import { Component, OnInit, ViewChild, ElementRef, AfterViewInit } from '@angular/core'; import { Router, ActivatedRoute } from '@angular/router'; import { MessagesService } from '@/app/core/services/messages.service'; import { mockRecipients, Recipient } from '../../../core/data/companies.mock'; import { Message } from '@/app/core/models'; export interface ForwardDraft { id: string; originalConversationId: string; recipientIds: string[]; subject: string; body: string; updatedAt: Date; } interface TextFormat { bold: boolean; italic: boolean; underline: boolean; strikethrough: boolean; } @Component({ selector: 'app-forward-conversation', template: `

FORWARD CONVERSATION

Company {{ originalMessage.company }}

{{ getRecipientName(recipientId) }}
{{ msg.isFromUser ? 'You' : msg.sender }}
{{ formatTimestamp(msg.timestamp) }}
{{ msg.content }}

You will loose all changes.

Are you sure you want to leave?

Draft correctly saved.
`, styles: [` @keyframes fade-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-10px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } } .animate-fade-in { animation: fade-in 0.3s ease-out; } textarea::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 6px; } textarea::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: #f1f1f1; } textarea::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: #888; border-radius: 3px; } textarea::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: #555; } `] }) export class ForwardConversationComponent implements OnInit, AfterViewInit { @ViewChild('recipientInput') recipientInputRef!: ElementRef; @ViewChild('messageBody') messageBodyRef!: ElementRef; recipients = mockRecipients; // Original conversation data conversationId: string = ''; originalMessage: Message | null = null; conversationThread: any[] = []; // Recipients selection selectedRecipientIds: string[] = []; // Typeahead recipientTypeahead = ''; recipientSuggestions: Recipient[] = []; showRecipientSuggestions = false; // Form fields subject = ''; body = ''; fontSize = '14'; // Rich text formatting textFormat: TextFormat = { bold: false, italic: false, underline: false, strikethrough: false }; // Auto-grow textarea textareaHeight = 100; maxTextareaHeight = 200; lineHeight = 20; // State isDirty = false; showUnsavedModal = false; showToast = false; constructor( private router: Router, private route: ActivatedRoute, private messagesService: MessagesService ) { } ngOnInit() { // Get conversation ID from route this.route.params.subscribe(params => { this.conversationId = params['id']; this.loadConversation(); }); } ngAfterViewInit() { this.adjustTextareaHeight(); } loadConversation() { // Load the original conversation this.originalMessage = this.messagesService.getMessageById(this.conversationId); if (this.originalMessage) { // Set subject with FW: prefix this.subject = `FW: ${this.originalMessage.subject}`; // Load conversation thread this.conversationThread = this.originalMessage.thread || []; } } // Recipients methods focusRecipientInput() { if (this.recipientInputRef) { setTimeout(() => this.recipientInputRef.nativeElement.focus(), 0); } } onRecipientTypeahead() { const query = this.recipientTypeahead.toLowerCase().trim(); if (query.length === 0) { this.recipientSuggestions = []; this.showRecipientSuggestions = false; return; } // Filter recipients based on original message company const companyId = this.originalMessage?.companyId; this.recipientSuggestions = this.recipients .filter(r => !companyId || r.companyId === companyId) .filter(r => !this.selectedRecipientIds.includes(r.id)) .filter(r => r.name.toLowerCase().includes(query) || r.role.toLowerCase().includes(query) ) .slice(0, 10); this.showRecipientSuggestions = this.recipientSuggestions.length > 0; } addRecipientFromTypeahead(recipient: Recipient) { if (!this.selectedRecipientIds.includes(recipient.id)) { this.selectedRecipientIds.push(recipient.id); this.markAsDirty(); } this.recipientTypeahead = ''; this.recipientSuggestions = []; this.showRecipientSuggestions = false; this.focusRecipientInput(); } onRecipientBlur() { setTimeout(() => { this.showRecipientSuggestions = false; }, 200); } removeRecipient(recipientId: string) { this.selectedRecipientIds = this.selectedRecipientIds.filter(id => id !== recipientId); this.markAsDirty(); } getRecipientName(recipientId: string): string { return this.recipients.find(r => r.id === recipientId)?.name || ''; } // Rich text editor methods toggleFormat(format: keyof TextFormat) { this.textFormat[format] = !this.textFormat[format]; this.markAsDirty(); } insertHighlight() { this.markAsDirty(); } insertBulletList() { const textarea = this.messageBodyRef?.nativeElement; if (textarea) { const start = textarea.selectionStart; const end = textarea.selectionEnd; const selectedText = this.body.substring(start, end); const lines = selectedText.split('\n'); const bulletList = lines.map(line => `• ${line}`).join('\n'); this.body = this.body.substring(0, start) + bulletList + this.body.substring(end); this.markAsDirty(); setTimeout(() => { textarea.selectionStart = start; textarea.selectionEnd = start + bulletList.length; textarea.focus(); }, 0); } } insertNumberedList() { const textarea = this.messageBodyRef?.nativeElement; if (textarea) { const start = textarea.selectionStart; const end = textarea.selectionEnd; const selectedText = this.body.substring(start, end); const lines = selectedText.split('\n'); const numberedList = lines.map((line, index) => `${index + 1}. ${line}`).join('\n'); this.body = this.body.substring(0, start) + numberedList + this.body.substring(end); this.markAsDirty(); setTimeout(() => { textarea.selectionStart = start; textarea.selectionEnd = start + numberedList.length; textarea.focus(); }, 0); } } insertLink() { const url = prompt('Enter URL:'); if (url) { const textarea = this.messageBodyRef?.nativeElement; if (textarea) { const start = textarea.selectionStart; const end = textarea.selectionEnd; const selectedText = this.body.substring(start, end) || url; const link = `[${selectedText}](${url})`; this.body = this.body.substring(0, start) + link + this.body.substring(end); this.markAsDirty(); } } } attachFile() { alert('File attachment functionality would be implemented here'); } // Auto-grow textarea onBodyInput() { this.markAsDirty(); this.adjustTextareaHeight(); } adjustTextareaHeight() { const textarea = this.messageBodyRef?.nativeElement; if (textarea) { textarea.style.height = 'auto'; const scrollHeight = textarea.scrollHeight; this.textareaHeight = Math.max(100, Math.min(scrollHeight, this.maxTextareaHeight)); } } handleKeydown(event: KeyboardEvent) { if (event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) { switch (event.key.toLowerCase()) { case 'b': event.preventDefault(); this.toggleFormat('bold'); break; case 'i': event.preventDefault(); this.toggleFormat('italic'); break; case 'u': event.preventDefault(); this.toggleFormat('underline'); break; } } } // Utility methods formatTimestamp(timestamp: Date): string { const date = new Date(timestamp); const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0'); const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0'); const year = date.getFullYear(); const hours = String(date.getHours()).padStart(2, '0'); const minutes = String(date.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0'); return `${day}.${month}.${year} ${hours}:${minutes} AM`; } // Form methods markAsDirty() { this.isDirty = true; } validateForm(): boolean { if (this.selectedRecipientIds.length === 0) { return false; } if (!this.subject.trim()) { return false; } return true; } onSend() { if (!this.validateForm()) { return; } console.log('Forwarding conversation:', { originalConversationId: this.conversationId, recipients: this.selectedRecipientIds, subject: this.subject, body: this.body, forwardedThread: this.conversationThread }); // TODO: Create new forwarded conversation // The new conversation should include: // 1. The forwarded messages (with "FORWARDED MESSAGES ABOVE" separator) // 2. The new message body this.isDirty = false; this.router.navigate(['/messages']); } onSaveDraft() { if (!this.isDirty) return; const draft: ForwardDraft = { id: 'forward-draft-' + Date.now(), originalConversationId: this.conversationId, recipientIds: [...this.selectedRecipientIds], subject: this.subject, body: this.body, updatedAt: new Date() }; const drafts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('forwardDrafts') || '[]'); drafts.push(draft); localStorage.setItem('forwardDrafts', JSON.stringify(drafts)); this.showToast = true; setTimeout(() => this.showToast = false, 3000); this.isDirty = false; this.router.navigate(['/messages', this.conversationId]); } onBack() { if (this.isDirty) { this.showUnsavedModal = true; } else { this.router.navigate(['/messages', this.conversationId]); } } onDontSave() { this.isDirty = false; this.showUnsavedModal = false; this.router.navigate(['/messages', this.conversationId]); } onSaveDraftAndLeave() { this.showUnsavedModal = false; this.onSaveDraft(); } }
